name: claude-review-for-codex
description: Experimental read-only Claude Code reviews and live-supervised disposable-worktree implementation for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Claude reviews plus live-supervised implementation in disposable worktrees.
interface.longDescription: Claude Review for Codex is an experimental v0.1 plugin that gives Codex a cost-aware second-opinion reviewer and an opt-in live-supervised implementation workflow. Claude can read bounded review context for advisory reviews, or write only inside a disposable worktree for $cr:implement; Codex streams Claude tool events, enforces scope and risk checks, runs configured tests, reviews diffs, records decisions, and remains the merge gate.
defaultPrompt: Ask Claude to review my diff, then have Codex fix valid findings.
Run an adversarial Claude review of this change.
Have Claude implement this in a disposable worktree while Codex watches, checks scope, runs tests, and supervises.
Verify whether the accepted Claude findings are fixed.
